semiconductor_relevance: High — Hatsuta Seisakusho specializes in automatic fire extinguishing systems specifically designed for semiconductor and LCD manufacturing lines.
summary: Hatsuta Seisakusho develops and manufactures automatic fire extinguishing systems, particularly the Cabinex series, which are tailored for the semiconductor and flat panel display industries. Their products are FM approved and designed to enhance safety in manufacturing environments by effectively suppressing fires without damaging equipment.
capabilities: FM approved carbon dioxide suppression systems
